goal: Create a photorealistic premium fashion commercial cut using front_master.png as the primary visual source of truth, with extremely strict front-view consistency, subtle breathing motion, stable identity, stable zari embroidery, and subtle wind-blown champagne satin backdrop dynamics.

engine_specs.camera_profile: High-end digital cinema fashion capture, clean color science, warm 3200K studio exposure

identity.instruction: Preserve the exact same virtual influencer identity, facial structure, skin tone, dark brown wavy hair, subtle dimple, and calm elegant expression throughout.
identity.expression_lock: Subtle proud, graceful catalog smile with soft eye engagement

attire.instruction: Preserve the exact Kalibherva maroon Anarkali gown: round embroidered yoke neckline with antique golden zari, micro-sequins, 3/4 sleeves with gold borders, and expansive 16-kali flared floor skirt. No pattern crawling or seam shifting.

accessories.instruction: Preserve antique gold temple earrings, right wrist bangles, and cream flat sandals. Zero drift in accessory placement.

environment_setup.location_type: Luminous champagne satin fabric studio set
environment_setup.backdrop_instruction: Maintain the ivory/champagne satin backdrop with gentle draped folds and floor pool. Background fabric exhibits subtle, elegant wind-blown drift.
environment_setup.lighting_instruction: 3200K warm tungsten key lighting with soft fill, highlighting gold embroidery specular sheen without burnout.
environment_setup.set_elements: Clean minimal luxury editorial set, zero clutter

motion_safety_rules.body_orientation: Keep the model fully front-facing or extremely slight 3/4 front-facing only. Never rotate enough to reveal side profile or back details.
motion_safety_rules.turn_limit: Strictly no spins, no half-turns, no side reveals, no back-facing movements.
motion_safety_rules.face_lock: Keep the facial identity completely locked. Zero morphing, zero expression drift, zero facial structure modification.
motion_safety_rules.garment_lock: Do not redesign or reinterpret gown details. Maintain exact zari motifs and kali pleat counts.
motion_safety_rules.background_lock: Ivory satin background style remains locked; only subtle fluid wind-blown drift is permitted.
motion_safety_rules.motion_style: Subtle, slow-motion grace: gentle micro-breathing, slight posture settling, faint hair movement.

motion_plan.core_goal: Deliver an ultra-luxurious 6-second front-view fashion portrait showcase with fluid slow-motion micro-dynamics and slow camera push-in.
motion_plan.camera_motion: Very slow, smooth cinematic push-in (dolly in) focusing subtly closer on the neckline embroidery and model expression without panning or tilting.
motion_plan.subject_motion: Natural subtle breathing, soft eye contact settling, imperceptible hand relaxation, gentle micro-movement of skirt hem.
motion_plan.fabric_motion: Background satin fabric exhibits a soft, slow, expensive ripple like a gentle high-fashion breeze.
motion_plan.hair_motion: Very slight natural settling of wavy hair strands against shoulders.

timeline_sequence.action: Hold the front anchor pose from front_master.png. Maintain steady front-facing posture, calm confident smile, and full gown embroidery clarity. Backdrop fabric begins a gentle slow drift.
Introduce subtle breathing motion and soft eye engagement. Camera executes a silky smooth slow push-in. Fabric catches golden key light with micro-sequin sparkles.
Gently decelerate camera dolly. Model holds serene, regal gaze. Backdrop fabric concludes graceful ripple. Video loops or cuts smoothly.

negative_prompt: extra legs, occlusion, extra fingers, identity drift, face morphing, flickering, jittering, hand position sliding, dress pattern crawling, lighting shifts, jerky neck movement, unnatural fabric stretching, side profile reveal, back reveal, cartoon, plastic skin, blurry, watermark
